def: A pipeline from Sakana AI and collaborators that proposes machine-learning research ideas, runs the experiments, writes a paper and reviews it automatically.
A language-model system that scores a paper using an ensemble of reviews and a meta-review, validated against real accept and reject decisions.
A final step in which the model acts as an area chair and decides on a paper given all of the individual reviews.
A small working code base for a topic that the first AI Scientist version edits to run its experiments.
A search in which each node is a version of experiment code with its results, buggy nodes are debugged and working nodes are refined best-first.
A literature search used to discard research ideas that are too similar to existing papers.
The average of the share of accepted papers correctly accepted and the share of rejected papers correctly rejected, which is 0.5 for a reviewer that ignores the paper.
The share of papers that should be rejected which a reviewer accepts.
The share of papers that should be accepted which a reviewer rejects.
Experimental results, such as an ablation table, that a system reports although it never ran the experiments.
